package.name: uav_camera
package.description:
The gimbal camera gateway. camera_node is the single owner of the SIYI A8 mini: it holds the one RTSP connection, the one SIYI SDK socket, and the one recording writer. Nothing else in the workspace may open either.
It carries NO detection, deliberately. Perception belongs in a package that SUBSCRIBES to this one, so that nothing contends for the camera and a detector that crashes or runs the Jetson out of memory cannot stop the recording — which is the artifact a flight exists to produce.
It also carries no gimbal AIMING beyond pointing straight down at startup. The missions need a fixed nadir view and a lat/lon per detection; they never need the camera to track a target, and a pointing loop is a control path that would have to be justified against README safety constraint 6.
